Estimate a shared noise model for ordered multichannel signals

Source: R/estimateSignalNoise.R
estimateSignalNoise.Rd

Estimate a shared noise model for ordered multichannel signals

Usage

estimateSignalNoise(
  y,
  family = quasipoisson("identity"),
  dispersion = NULL,
  theta = NULL,
  weights = NULL,
  correlation = "none",
  censor = 0.5,
  ncores = NULL
)

Arguments

y

Observations-by-channels matrix.

family

Identity-link family accepted by [splogconNMF()].

dispersion, theta

Fixed noise parameters, or NULL to estimate them.

weights

Scalar, row vector or matrix of observation precisions.

correlation

Correlation convention used by [splogconNMF()].

censor

Gamma detection limit.

ncores

Number of physical worker cores; NULL detects them.

Value

A list containing the fitted noise specification, pilot means and equivalent Poisson working precision for PSF diagnostics.

Details

Pooled marginal variances are estimated from temporal differences. A shared information factor accounts for estimated lag-one correlation. The same calibration can be reused during PSF estimation and factorization.
